scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Welcome to the
Lighthalzen Airport,
where we offer nonstop
flights to Einbroch, Juno and Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇机场，
我们提供前往艾音布罗克、朱诺和毁葛的直达航班。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
The boarding fee is
1,200 zeny, but you can
waive the fee if you redeem
a Free Ticket for Airship.
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
登机费为1,200泽尼，
但如果您使用飞空艇免费券，
即可免除费用。

scripts.text:
[Airship Staff]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have 1,200 zeny to pay
for the boarding fee.
scripts.translation:
[飞空艇工作人员]
很抱歉，您的泽尼不足1,200，
无法支付登机费。

scripts.text:
[Airport Staff]
Thank you and
please come again.
Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[机场工作人员]
谢谢惠顾，
欢迎再次光临。
祝您愉快~

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Welcome to Lighthalzen Airport.
Please let me guide you to the
main terminal if you are arriving from your flight. Otherwise, please
board the departing Airship to reach your intended destination.
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
欢迎来到里希塔乐镇机场。
如果您是刚下飞机，请让我引导您前往主航站楼。
否则，请搭乘出发的飞空艇前往您的目的地。

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Once you're in the main terminal, you will need to pay the fee again
to board an Airship. You should
only exit if Lighthalzen is your intended destination. Shall we
proceed to the main terminal?
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
一旦进入主航站楼，您需要再次付费才能搭乘飞空艇。
只有当里希塔乐镇是您的目的地时，才应该离开。
要前往主航站楼吗？

scripts.text:
[Arrival Staff]
Alright, thank you
for your patronage
and I hope you have
a pleasant flight~
scripts.translation:
[到达区工作人员]
好的，感谢您的惠顾，
祝您旅途愉快~
